_about: Demand events: short, named spikes or crashes in the demand for one or more colors, in every market. Events start at random times (balance.json demand.event_interval_min_ms and event_interval_max_ms), and each start chooses one event from this list at random. Each event: id, name, colors (color ids), direction ("spike" or "crash"), size (a spike of 0.5 makes demand 1.5 times as high; a crash of 0.4 makes it 0.6 times as high, and a crash must be less than 1), and duration_ms. With no events, no demand events occur. PLACEHOLDER sizes and durations until playtests set them.
